title: The safe life cost me *my twenties*

head: I treated the gym as optional
sub: Lifting 4x a week teaches you to keep promises. No class did that.

head: Years of study, zero real skills
sub: Teaching myself to film paid more than the degree. Learn one skill people pay for.

head: I saved every euro and spent nothing on me
sub: Keep saving. But money spent on skills and trips isn't wasted.

head: Proving myself to people who weren't watching
sub: Nobody kept score. The only judge that counts is you at 40.

label: THE REAL REGRET
head: I never went anywhere
sub: Book one trip a year. Before you feel ready, not after.

text: Playing it safe still costs you *a whole decade.*

head: Play it *less safe*
sub: Your twenties don't come with a refund.
